Best 80 hours of a game

Now before you write off this review since it says I haven't played all that much of the game, I did get all the trophies for it on PS4. Hollow Knight is THE metroidvania game. it's the best one for newcomers to the genre, it's the best ones for veterans of the genre who have already played games like Symphony of The Night or Metroid as well as their many sequels. I went into the game very very unsure if I'd enjoy it and in just an hour and some change i was hooked and dedicated months to doing just about everything in the game. The combat is perfectly balanced, the movement once you have all the abilities the game makes you find is amazingly smooth, the soundtrack is way too good for a game at this scale and the story while not direct is just enough to make you curious. it's a challenging but amazing romp all the way through. So if you're even slightly considering trying it out. do it. Even if you have to use a guide. It's still worth it.
10/10 Game

If you are into games that you can play for fun or make you suffer then this is a game for you. If you are into really hard platforming games then this is a game for you. If you are into souls like games, then  this is a game for you. If you just want to play a game that has really smooth gameplay then this a game for you. Last but not least, if you are into 2d games then this is a game for you. This game has really good music as well, so if you are into that type of thing then this is also a really good game to try. Also, the art is beautiful in this game as well.

You learn to love the pain of trial and error, and after awhile you'll be surprised that you're even capable of doing the things you're watching yourself do on the screen. Some of the bosses in the very, very late parts of the game if you're trying to go for completion are ridiculously hard, though, so this game is not for the faint of heart.

I'm a pretty casual gamer. So I can't speak to specs, or speed runs or anything like that. But if you're looking for a game with a beautiful art style and a pretty but melancholic (and occasionally spooky) tone then this game is for you! You definitely have to grow your skills as you go through the game lest you get stuck on a boss fight for a while, and there's some spots that stumped me playing through it the first time. But the story, art, music, and overall vibe definitely make it worth it.
